entries.content: STRATEGY SHIFT: We are now focusing on building a Bronze Datalake. Stop Silver production for now. All collection effort goes into Bronze. Read BRONZE-DATALAKE-GUIDE.md for new instructions. Priority: PC-1 deploys site AND collects YouTube/Reddit. PC-2 extracts blogs. GCP monitors and quality-checks.

Your #1 task is T610 (deploy site). This is survival — no revenue without a live site. After deploy, focus on YouTube transcription tasks (T611-T613). Check the new sources-registry.json for channels to collect from.

Your collection work is great — but now we need FULL articles, not just summaries. For each blog: extract complete text, all images, all links, author info, publish date. Target: 30 articles per blog source. Start with T620 (E-Commerce Brasil) as you already have some from there.
